prompt.es: El tren se cancela. Debes pedir ayuda y mantener el viaje. ¿Qué dices?

choices.text: Could you help me confirm the new departure time?
Could you help me find the replacement bus?
Could you show me where the information desk is?

prompt.es: Redacta el plan con cada dato y reproduce la petición entre comillas.

answer.text: I will reserve a return ticket to Leeds for the 9:10 departure and confirm platform four. From the station, I will go past the museum. If the train is cancelled, I will say, ‘Could you help me find bus 22, please?’ My alternative is bus 22 at 9:40.
accepted: I will reserve a return ticket to Leeds for the 9:10 departure and confirm platform four. From the station, I will go past the museum. If the train is cancelled, I will say, ‘Could you help me find bus 22, please?’ My alternative is bus 22 at 9:40.

My itinerary has a return ticket to Leeds, a 9:10 departure from platform four and a route past the museum. If the train is cancelled, I will ask, ‘Could you help me find bus 22, please?’ I will take bus 22 at 9:40 instead.

feedback.es: El plan usa todos los datos visibles y no inventa la petición ni la alternativa.

origin.text: Return ticket to Leeds; 9:10, platform 4; go past the museum. The train is cancelled. Say: ‘Could you help me find bus 22, please?’ Alternative: bus 22 at 9:40.

answer.text: Confirm the connection before leaving the station.

prompt.es: Une cada riesgo del itinerario con su respuesta.

feedback.es: El retraso cambia la hora; la cancelación activa la alternativa preparada.

prompt.es: Crea el plan de Norwich y reproduce la petición indicada.

answer.text: I will reserve a single ticket to Norwich for 7:45 and confirm platform three. I will cross the square. If the coach is delayed, I will say, ‘Could you help me find the taxi stand, please?’ My alternative is a taxi at 8:10.

feedback.es: El repaso integra los cinco conceptos en Norwich, un escenario distinto al de Leeds.
